FormulaExpression:
IF(%Order:Status% == "InPayment", "En Proceso de Pago", 
    IF(%Order:Status% == "DeliveryAndActivated", "En Proceso de Entrega/Activación", 
    IF(%Order:Status% == "Draft", "Diseño de la Oferta",
    IF(%Order:Status% == "Activated", "Cerrada Ganada", 
    IF(%Order:Status% == "Closed", "Oferta Cerrada", %Order:Status%)))))
Name: FVU_GetOrderDetailsGlobalHeader

FormulaExpression: IF(ISNOTBLANK(QUERY("SELECT Id FROM OrderItem WHERE Product2.Family = 'Device' AND FVU_ProductDeliveryStatus__c = 'ReadyForPickup' AND OrderId = '{0}'", Order:Id)), true, false)
Name: FVU_GetOrderDetailsGlobalHeader
